29913.subject: Technical Drawing
29913.question_text: Construct a perpendicular bisector to a line segment AB of length 60 mm. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
29913.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 60 mm.
2. With A as center, draw an arc with radius greater than half of AB.
3. With B as center, draw another arc of the same radius to intersect the first arc at points C and D.
4. Join C and D to form the perpendicular bisector of AB.
5. Label all points and construction lines.

29914.subject: Technical Drawing
29914.question_text: Construct a regular hexagon with side length 30 mm using the circumscribed circle method. Show all construction lines.
29914.explanation:
1. Draw a circle with radius 30 mm.
2. Divide the circumference into six equal parts using a 60° set square or protractor.
3. Join the points on the circumference to form the hexagon.
4. Label all construction lines and vertices.

29915.subject: Technical Drawing
29915.question_text: Construct an external tangent to two circles of radii 20 mm and 30 mm, with centers 70 mm apart. Show all construction lines.
29915.explanation:
1. Draw the two circles with centers O1 and O2.
2. Join O1 and O2.
3. Draw a circle with radius (30 - 20) mm = 10 mm centered at O2.
4. Construct the perpendicular bisector of O1O2 and find the midpoint M.
5. With M as center, draw an arc of radius MO1 to intersect the 10 mm circle at point P.
6. Join O2P and extend to meet the larger circle at T2.
7. Draw a line parallel to O2P through O1 to meet the smaller circle at T1.
8. Join T1T2 to form the external tangent.

29916.subject: Technical Drawing
29916.question_text: Draw the front, top, and right-side views of the given isometric block (dimensions: 40 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm). Use first-angle projection.
29916.explanation:
1. Front view: 40 mm (width) × 20 mm (height).
2. Top view: 40 mm (width) × 30 mm (depth).
3. Right-side view: 30 mm (depth) × 20 mm (height).
4. Align views correctly in first-angle projection.
5. Label all views and dimensions.

29917.subject: Technical Drawing
29917.question_text: Draw a full sectional front view of the given object (a hollow cylinder with an external diameter of 50 mm, internal diameter of 30 mm, and height of 40 mm). Use appropriate hatching.
29917.explanation:
1. Draw the front view as a rectangle 50 mm × 40 mm.
2. Draw the internal hole as a rectangle 30 mm × 40 mm.
3. Apply hatching at 45° to the sectioned areas.
4. Label dimensions and section lines.

29918.subject: Technical Drawing
29918.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a rectangular block with dimensions 50 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm. Include all construction lines.
29918.explanation:
1. Draw the isometric axes at 30° to the horizontal.
2. Mark lengths along the axes: 50 mm (length), 30 mm (width), 20 mm (height).
3. Complete the block by drawing parallel lines.
4. Label all dimensions and construction lines.

29919.subject: Technical Drawing
29919.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a right circular cone with base diameter 40 mm and slant height 50 mm. Show all construction lines.
29919.explanation:
1. Calculate the circumference of the base: $C = \pi d = \pi imes 40$ mm.
2. Draw a sector of a circle with radius 50 mm and arc length equal to the circumference.
3. The sector angle $ heta$ is calculated as $ heta = rac{C}{2 \pi r} imes 360° = rac{40 imes 360°}{2 imes 50} = 144°$.
4. Draw the sector and label all dimensions.

29920.subject: Technical Drawing
29920.question_text: Draw the line of interpenetration between a vertical cylinder (diameter 40 mm) and a horizontal cylinder (diameter 30 mm) intersecting at right angles. Show all construction lines.
29920.explanation:
1. Draw the front and top views of both cylinders.
2. Divide the circumference of the horizontal cylinder into 12 equal parts in the top view.
3. Project these points to the front view.
4. Draw lines of intersection by connecting corresponding points.
5. Label all construction lines and points.

29921.subject: Technical Drawing
29921.question_text:
Dimension the given orthographic views (front and top) of a stepped block with the following features:
- Overall length: 80 mm
- Overall width: 50 mm
- Overall height: 40 mm
- Step height: 20 mm
- Step depth: 30 mm
Use standard dimensioning conventions.
29921.explanation:
1. Dimension the overall length (80 mm) on the top view.
2. Dimension the overall width (50 mm) on the top view.
3. Dimension the overall height (40 mm) on the front view.
4. Dimension the step height (20 mm) and depth (30 mm) on the front view.
5. Use extension lines, dimension lines, and arrowheads correctly.
6. Place dimensions outside the views where possible.

29922.subject: Technical Drawing
29922.question_text:
Produce a working drawing of a simple bracket with the following specifications:
- Base plate: 60 mm × 40 mm × 10 mm
- Vertical plate: 40 mm × 30 mm × 10 mm
- Hole diameter: 15 mm (centered on the vertical plate)
Include all necessary views, dimensions, and a title block.
29922.explanation:
1. Draw the front and top views of the bracket.
2. Dimension all features: base plate (60 × 40 × 10 mm), vertical plate (40 × 30 × 10 mm), and hole (15 mm diameter).
3. Include a title block with the following details: title (BRACKET), scale, date, name, and material.
4. Use standard dimensioning conventions and line types.
